acquisition method: The ten most intense peptide ions from the preview scan in the Orbitrap were fragmented
alkylation reagent: 50 mM iodoacetamide was added for 30 min and incubated in the dark for alkylation
alkylation concentration: 50 mM iodoacetamide was added for 30 min
cleavage agent: dehydrated samples were digested in 12.5 ng/ml Trypsin Gold (Promega)
collision energy: fragmented by collision induced dissociation (normalized collision energy 35% and resolution of 17,500)
enrichment method: After trap enrichment, peptides were eluted in a PepMap C18 nanocolumn
fractionation method: Each lane was divided into four gel slices.
fragmentation method: fragmented by collision induced dissociation (normalized collision energy 35% and resolution of 17,500)
instrument: The HPLC system was coupled to an OrbiTrap QExactive mass spectrometer
ionization type: coupled to an OrbiTrap QExactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc) via an EasySpray source
labeling: We performed quantification based on protein intensities.
reduction reagent: Biopsies were then incubated in 2.5% SDS, 50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 10 mM dithiothréitol at 98 °C for 1 h.
